newsitem.title: USA: SBC Warburg seeks to buy Dillon, Read firm - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg seeks to buy Dillon, Read firm - WSJ.

text.p: SBC Warburg is expected to announce a deal to buy the investment banking firm of Dillon, Read & Co for about $600 million, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the planned acquisition by the Swiss-British investment bank marks the latest in a series of European investment banks buying access into the U.S. investment-banking market.
The news comes as financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV pulled out of talks on Wednesday to acquire Dillon Read.

Spokesmen for SBC Warburg and Dillon Read declined to comment, the Journal said. However, the newspaper said managing directors at Dillon Read were told of the proposed takeover during meetings on Wednesday.
